normalization: unquote enclosing ASCII double quotes for analysis; whitespace-normalized match removes whitespace only; does not emulate CustomScript
sample_method: 10 purposively selected contiguous 20-unit scenes spanning opening, four heroine routes, past chapter and final chapter; 3 context units each side when available; not random and not a corpus-wide semantic score.
semantic_review_method: Codex internal read Japanese source and patch text for 15 purposively selected contiguous 20-unit windows plus neighboring context; 4 heroine routes and endings, opening, past and final chapter. No random-population accuracy estimate.
source_version: original disc overlaid with 179 MJO entries from supplied official update101; one additional developer copy tracked; 182 total source scripts
corpus_caveat: Counts include all extracted script text fields, including developer/test fragments. Speaker tokens and inline ldstr/ruby are separate from this denominator. A text match is not a translation-correctness or runtime-coverage claim.
